text:
nina: Heads-up — found a new-ish streaming glitch in the onboarding sample where the browser UI shows partial JSON but go/python/node SDKs complete fine. Might be a combination of heartbeat handling + split UTF-8 bytes across chunks.
raj: interesting, split UTF-8? that's new. repro steps?
nina: examples/streaming-onboard. Start local proxy + open page. Trigger LONG_PROMPT. Happens ~1/10 runs. Browser console: `Unexpected token \u0000 in JSON at position 0` or truncated parse. Server logs look fine.
oliver: paste logs/snips?
nina: 
```
[1809999999.123Z] runtime: emit seq=34 data="{\"text\": \"Hel"
[1809999999.124Z] runtime: keepalive (empty event)
[1809999999.125Z] runtime: emit seq=35 data="lo \uD83D"
[1809999999.126Z] runtime: emit seq=36 data="DE0A\", \"more\": 1}"
[1809999999.127Z] client/browser: EventSource.onerror -> close
[1809999999.128Z] parser ERROR: JSON.parse failed after seq=35
```
nina: note seq=35 contains a surrogate half of an emoji (\uD83D) — if the client `e.data` is concatenated naïvely per chunk and parsed before seq=36 arrives (because of an early onerror triggered by keepalive+proxy abort), JSON.parse fails. Go/python SDKs use streaming decoder that handles split multi-byte/UTF-8 sequences more gracefully.
grace: ahh I've seen similar in other systems — TextDecoder and incremental decoding matters. Browser sample-app just does `buf += e.data; try { JSON.parse(buf) } catch {}` which breaks if surrogate pairs are split or if a multi-byte UTF-8 sequence is cut mid-byte.
raj: two orthogonal issues then: 1) heartbeat/onerror races causing premature finalization, and 2) chunk-level encoding boundaries causing parse errors.
oliver: mitigation suggestions: - use a streaming TextDecoder in the web helper to reassemble raw bytes rather than relying on `e.data` strings; - debounce heartbeats (50-100ms) and treat them as non-terminal; - runtime to emit explicit `event: keepalive` and `event: final` (avoid blank-data semantics).
grace: I can prototype a small helper for the sample-app: sseBinaryReassembler() that accepts ArrayBuffer frames and uses TextDecoder({fatal:false}) with `decoder.decode(partial, {stream:true})` to safely rebuild UTF-8 text across boundaries. Also fallback to current logic if browser doesn't support streaming decode.
raj: good. Also add an opt-in short grace window on onerror (e.g., 120ms) before finishing for browsers — only in sample-app helper, not SDK core, to avoid masking real disconnects. Document tradeoffs.
nina: I opened a tiny repro that simulates (1) empty keepalive + proxy CRLF, (2) split-UTF8 across seq boundary, (3) auth-refresh reconnect mid-stream. Auth-refresh sometimes triggers the proxy to close+reopen which in turn causes EventSource to emit onerror rapidly.
oliver: SDK parity note: node SDK uses `eventsource` polyfill which presents binary data differently (gives complete strings) and go/python use lower-level streams — so behavior diverges. We should add a DX note in streaming docs: recommend using the helper until SDK parity is fixed.
grace: quick patch idea for sample-app: add sseBinaryReassembler + debounceKeepalive + onerrorGrace. Test harness: run headless chrome against the harness with random split points and injected CRLF-abort to reproduce.
raj: add unit tests that intentionally split multibyte chars across chunks and assert reassembler returns valid JSON.
nina: CI: tried the helper branch locally — 50/50 -> 100/100 on 20 runs. PR #4592 has the helper + docs + small tests.
ci-bot: CI: streaming-e2e on PR #4592 passed 24/24.
oliver: long-term: runtime RFC to emit explicit `event:` lines and provide a small stable framing (seq/resume/event) so clients don't rely on whitespace rules. That will simplify SDKs.
grace: agreed. Will draft a minimal helper we can upstream into the official web SDK as a compatibility shim. Also add a short DX blurb about proxies normalizing CRLF and the importance of streaming TextDecoder.
raj: thanks. Follow-ups: INFRA ticket to log CRLF insertions on abort path, runtime RFC for explicit events, and SDK parity checklist item to add streaming TextDecoder helper.
nina: thanks all — landing the sample-app helper now. If folks want to dogfood, enable LONG_PROMPT in onboarding. :seedling:
